# `fintech_txn_status_valid`

> Transactions are posted, pending or reversed; only posted ones move balances.

| | |
|---|---|
| Domain | [fintech](README.md) |
| Layer | **silver** — evaluated by the `silver` gate |
| Model | `slv_fintech__transactions` (`fintech_silver.slv_fintech__transactions`) |

| Check | `accepted_values` |

## What it checks

`status` is one of: `posted`, `pending`, `reversed`.

## When it fails

The `silver` task of `medallion_fintech` fails, gold and `publish_gold` don't run, and the batch is never added to `fintech_gold`: consumers keep the batches published before. `quality_report` marks the run as blocked and sends the alert, if one is configured.

The rows that broke the rule in its latest evaluation are kept in `dq_audit.fintech_txn_status_valid`.

## Tested by

No sample-data scenario trips this rule yet: it guards against cases the generators don't produce.
